subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Timed reading practice and Time to Talk: ranking the tips
outcomes: Read a text quickly, record the time and calculate your WPM
Answer questions after reading and aim for 75% accuracy
Rank tips for new students and give reasons

tf.s: You should answer the questions while you are reading the text.
tf.why: Answer after reading; answering during reading distracts you.

tf.s: In timed reading, you should aim for 75% accuracy.
You need a timer that shows seconds.
tf.why: Seconds help you calculate your exact speed.

tf.s: You should look back at the text when you answer the questions.
tf.why: You answer the questions without looking back.

tf.s: Recording your WPM helps you see if you are improving.
tf.why: You can compare it with later readings.

tf.s: Reading fast without understanding is the aim of timed reading.
tf.why: The aim is to read fast while still understanding.

tf.s: In Time to Talk, students rank tips for new students.
tf.why: Yes, they put the tips in order of importance.

tf.s: 6 correct answers out of 10 is a score of 75%.
You only need to record your finish time.
tf.why: You record both start and finish times.

boxes.q: What do you record before you start reading?
boxes.why: You need the start time to work out how long you took.

boxes.q: When do you answer the questions?
What do you do with the seconds before calculating?
In Time to Talk, how do you rank the tips first?
boxes.why: You rank alone first, then compare in groups.

boxes.q: How many tips do students rank?
boxes.why: There are nine tips to rank.

boxes.q: Why should you answer without looking back at the text?
boxes.why: It shows how much you understood while reading.

boxes.q: What happens in the whole-class vote?
boxes.why: The class votes for the most valuable tip.

boxes.q: What is the best aim in timed reading?

hunt.q: Put tips in order of importance

mcq.q: Why must you answer the questions after reading, not during?
mcq.why: Focus on reading first, then answer.

mcq.q: What must everyone be able to see during timed reading?
mcq.why: An accurate timer gives an exact reading time.

mcq.q: Which two times do you record?
o: The time of the next lesson
mcq.why: Finish time minus start time = reading time.

mcq.q: After ranking the tips alone, what do students do?
mcq.why: They compare and defend their choices.

mcq.q: Aisha read 480 words in 4 minutes. What is her speed?
Yousuf read a 700-word text. He started at 10:02:00 and finished at 10:05:30. What is his speed?
Salim answered 12 of 16 questions correctly. What is his score?
Why is it useful to record your WPM and score every time?
o: To compare with later readings and see progress
mcq.why: Records show if you are improving.

mcq.q: Why is speed without understanding not enough?
o: The aim is to read fast while still understanding
mcq.why: Reading is only useful if you understand it.

mcq.q: Student A reads at 300 wpm and scores 40%. Student B reads at 200 wpm and scores 80%. Who met the 75% aim?
